sections.content: Add -k to make a noun plural. After a consonant, a linking vowel goes in first, and it follows vowel harmony: back words take -ok, front words take -ek (or -ök).
sections.title: Making nouns plural

sections.content: The linking vowel matches the word's own vowels — asztal has back vowels so it takes -ok, szék has a front vowel so it takes -ek. Guessing the wrong one is the most common beginner slip.
